notes.title: 《神树残响》商店页及demo公开！
notes.content: Our next yuri card battle RPG "Echoes of the Divine Tree" has now opened its store page and demo release. If you're interested in our new game, add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: 1.31- 【 Small Patch Collection Update 】
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the healing skill movements of Hecate, and enhanced the skill effects and movements of [Ritual Combo].

3. Fixed some typos.
4. Optimized the dialogue reaction after some events.

notes.title: 1.30 -【 Small Patch Collection Update 】
notes.content:
1. Fixed environmental sound residues in the Eastern suburbs of old town in Serbia and the Serbian wilderness highlands between moving in a specific area.
2. Fixed an issue with a map event loop after completing the DLC.
3. Part of the text has been amended.
4. Fixed several block errors in Isabel Castle.
5. Fixed 2 bugs in Sunset Temple.
6. Adjustments were made to an area of the Elk Temple.
7. Added a hint auxiliary task to Green Feather's delegation - The whereabouts of Char (does not affect the old archive)
8. Add a new recipe for dessert.
9. The error in the order of events generated by the auxiliary task [The whereabouts of Char] has been fixed.If you have completed or have not yet accepted the commission of Banaime  Cotton, ignore.
(This task should be triggered only after the completion of "Lift the seal of the Green Eye". If it is triggered in advance, the target person will not appear, and it must be triggered only after the completion of "Lift the seal of the Green Eye" and obtaining information from the Red Leaf Newspaper. If it has been triggered, the above contents need to be completed)
10. Adjusted the map screen of Noble Street.
11. Added hints for some event triggers.
